_note: Every part of the suite. A project picks each one as-is, adapted or skip in its .agent-suite.json (parts). needs: bins on PATH, env keys, other parts; optional needs only turn a feature on. hooks: what tools/install_team.py wraps into the project's .claude/settings.json ({suite} is this folder). leaves_machine: what, if anything, goes off the machine. Commands run from the suite folder; DIR is the project folder.

cockpit.does: Local page for the owner: milestone and goal, what each session does, open asks answered in a grill round, token use; the autopilot that compacts, clears and keeps caches warm by rules the owner turns on; controls checked on screen; health lights
config: DIR/.cockpit.json (paths, team, port), over ~/.config/cockpit/config.json; schema in cockpit/cockpit/project_config/config_schema.py
cockpit.install: python3 cockpit/tools/install_project.py install DIR (status line and pause guard, with a backup)
cockpit.verify: python3 cockpit/cockpit.py --project DIR, open the url it prints; the header lists any source it cannot read
cockpit.leaves_machine: Reads the public price page. With TYPESAFE_API_KEY set, the task classifier sends a ticket's title and notes to TypeSafe. Nothing else

panel.does: Every question to the owner goes on one panel with options, a recommendation and a why; only the ask tool writes it; a reply that asks the owner without a panel ask is held; one waiter reports answers

messages.does: Session-to-session messages: one event, one recipient; a result line carries real counts; a relay quotes its author word for word; every message logged

saved-guard.does: A reply that says something was saved, landed, committed or pushed must name it (a sha, a ticket, a file); each hold is logged for the cockpit's said-vs-saved view

receipts.does: A test receipt with a new skip marker or a lower count is refused; a landed commit must match the reviewed frozen patch (tree, message, patch-id, no tool attribution)
receipts.install: nothing to install: the author runs receipt_guards.py before a GO-REQ, the lead runs verify_landing.py after landing

pause.does: One file pauses the team: while it exists, commits, pushes, claims, messages and model runs are denied and logged
pause.install: python3 tools/install_team.py install DIR (the cockpit part installs its own pause guard, so this hook is skipped when the cockpit is chosen)

memory.does: Engram as the team's memory: paste-ready rules, a nudge to save after 15 minutes without a save, a summary and a fresh role state after every compaction, a migration from markdown memory files
config: the Engram project name, in the pasted rules
memory.install: python3 tools/install_team.py install DIR; paste docs/RULES.md "Memory" into the project's CLAUDE.md; add Engram's MCP server with cloud sync off
memory.verify: engram search test --project PROJECT; python3 tools/doctor.py DIR
memory.leaves_machine: no, with Engram's cloud sync off (check: no cloud target set, ENGRAM_CLOUD_AUTOSYNC unset)

queue.does: The task queue (in_flight.json: tickets in flight, waiting on the owner, next per session); one ticket in progress per session as a hard block on the claim; the courier that hands a free session its next ticket and nudges an idle one
queue.install: python3 tools/install_team.py install DIR; start the courier detached: nohup python3 tools/team/courier.py > BOARD/courier.log 2>&1 & echo $! > BOARD/courier.pid
queue.uninstall: python3 tools/install_team.py uninstall DIR; kill the pid in BOARD/courier.pid

slots.does: Named resources granted one holder at a time with a waiting line (a simulator, a heavy build, a test database); a hold past twice its minutes is flagged

snapshot.does: Copies the board, an export of the tickets and the memory folders to a private git repo after each push, behind a secret scan
snapshot.install: the owner creates the private repo; write snapshot in DIR/.agent-suite.json
snapshot.uninstall: remove snapshot from the config; the private repo stays until the owner deletes it
snapshot.leaves_machine: yes: the board, the tickets and the memory folders go to snapshot.remote. Needs the owner's yes

team-check.does: Prints one line per finding (two tickets in progress, a stale one, idle with ready work, a closed ticket in flight, an overdue slot) and exits 1, so a timer wakes the coordinator only on a finding
team-check.install: a timer (launchd, cron or the cockpit) runs it every 20 minutes and prompts the coordinator with its output when it exits 1

launcher.does: The claude wrapper: session name from the herdr pane label, the role's launch flags from team.json, the saved flags back on a bare resume; exports AGENT_SESSION for the guards
launcher.install: python3 tools/install_team.py install DIR; set AGENT_SUITE to this folder and source templates/shell/claude.sh (bash, zsh) or copy claude.fish to ~/.config/fish/functions/; write BOARD/team.json from templates/team.json
launcher.uninstall: python3 tools/install_team.py uninstall DIR; remove the wrapper from the shell

protocol.does: The roles (lead, coordinator, reviewer, worker), the message types and who sends what, the lead-coordinator flow, review by risk, and a prompt template per role
protocol.install: copy the role templates the team uses into the project, fill {{session}}, {{folders}} and {{decision_log}}
protocol.verify: each session's prompt names its role, its folders and docs/PROTOCOL.md

rules.does: Ready-to-paste rule text for each gentle-ai idea and the Engram conventions
rules.install: paste the chosen blocks into the project's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md
rules.verify: the project's guide holds the pasted blocks
